item.title: Martindale Brightwood Data Center Moves Forward Despite Resident Outcry
item.description: A 14-acre urban data center proposed for Martindale Brightwood will move forward following a vote of recommendation from a hearing examiner on Thursday, Feb. 12 over the objections of many area residents.

item.title: Indy 500 Grandstand Sales Trending Toward Another Sellout
item.description: Organizers say ticket demand for the 110th running of the Indianapolis 500 is rising quickly as the race reaches the 100-day countdown, with sales at the fastest pace since the event’s centennial edition in 2016.

item.title: Indiana Senate Sends ‘Let Kids Be Kids’ Child Supervision Bill To Governor
